Gideon.title: Gideon
Gideon.question: When God calls the unlikely, will we trust His strength over our own?

chapters.title: The Winepress
chapters.game: Thresh wheat in hiding, hear the Angel's call.

chapters.title: The Sign
chapters.game: Prepare the offering, witness fire from the rock.

chapters.title: The Fleece
chapters.game: Lay out the fleece, check for dew at dawn.

chapters.title: The Army Reduced
chapters.game: Watch men drink, identify the 300 who lap.

chapters.title: The Dream
chapters.game: Creep to the camp, overhear the barley cake dream.

chapters.title: The Battle
chapters.game: Shatter jars, blow trumpets, hold torches high.

chapters.title: The Victory
chapters.game: Pursue the kings, declare the Lord's rule.
